substrate_material: Si(111), a-plane sapphire, MOCVD GaN/a-plane sapphire
evidence: III-nitride ternary layers (AlInN, InGaN, and AlGaN) were simultaneously grown on semi-insulating Si(111) and a-plane sapphire substrates as well as on MOCVD GaN/a-plane sapphire templates, using a n Ultratech/Cambridge Nano Tech Fiji 200 ALD system. Ex situ surface cleaning and the process flow of ternary growth was identical to that of the binary (InN and AlN) growth reported elsewhere.
